38768-south-africa-and-the-transvaal-war.title: Transvaal War
38768-south-africa-and-the-transvaal-war.creator: Unknown
38768-south-africa-and-the-transvaal-war.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. 12-13.--General French, following up Hannay's movement, crossed Riet River, and next day with a strong force marched twenty-five miles into the Free State, seized Klip Drift on the Modder River, occupied the hills to the north, and captured three of the enemy's laagers, with supplies.

arxiv-2011-06454.title: Boosting photonic quantum computation with moderate nonlinearity
arxiv-2011-06454.creator: A. Pick, E. S. Matekole, Z. Aqua, G. Guendelman, O. Firstenberg, J. P. Dowling, B. Dayan
arxiv-2011-06454.description: Abstract Photonic measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) is a promising route towards fault-tolerant universal quantum computing. A central challenge in this effort is the huge overhead in the resources required for the construction of large photonic clusters using probabilistic linear-optics gates. Although strong single-photon nonlinearity ideally enables deterministic construction of such clusters, it is challenging to realise in a scalable way.

arxiv-2212-00783.title: Collision detection for N N -body Kepler systems
arxiv-2212-00783.creator: P.M. Visser
arxiv-2212-00783.description: Abstract Context. In a Keplerian system, a large number of bodies orbit a central mass. Accretion disks, protoplanetary disks, asteroid belts, and planetary rings are examples. Simulations of these systems require algorithms that are computationally efficient. The inclusion of collisions in the simulations is challenging but important. Aims.

arxiv-2301-10440.title: Scheduling Space Expander: An Extension of Concurrency Control for Data Ingestion Queries
arxiv-2301-10440.creator: Sho Nakazono, Hiroyuki Uchiyama, Yasuhiro Fujiwara, Hideyuki Kawashima
arxiv-2301-10440.description: Abstract . With the continuing advances of sensing devices and IoT applications, database systems needs to process data ingestion queries that update the sensor data frequently. To process data ingestion queries with transactional correctness, we propose a novel protocol extension method, scheduling space expander (SSE).

arxiv-2304-10346.title: Interventional Probing in High Dimensions: An NLI Case Study
arxiv-2304-10346.creator: Julia Rozanova, Marco Valentino, Lucas Cordeiro, André Freitas, University of Manchester, United Kingdom, {firstname.lastname}@manchester.ac.uk, Idiap Research Institute, Switzerland, {firstname.lastname}@idiap.ch
arxiv-2304-10346.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Julia Rozanova, Marco Valentino, Lucas Cordeiro, André Freitas, University of Manchester, United Kingdom, {firstname.lastname}@manchester.ac.uk, Idiap Research Institute, Switzerland, {firstname.lastname}@idiap.ch. Probing strategies have been shown to detect the presence of various linguistic features in large language models; in particular, semantic features intermediate to the “natural logic" fragment of the Natural Language Inference task (NLI).

arxiv-2308-13365.title: Expressive paragraph text-to-speech synthesis with multi-step variational autoencoder
arxiv-2308-13365.creator: Xuyuan Li ♠†⋆, Zengqiang Shang ♢♠⋆, Peiyang Shi ♠, Hua Hua ♠†, Ta Li ♠†, Pengyuan Zhang ♢♠†
arxiv-2308-13365.description: Abstract Neural networks have been able to generate high-quality single-sentence speech. However, it remains a challenge concerning audio-book speech synthesis due to the intra-paragraph correlation of semantic and acoustic features as well as variable styles. In this paper, we propose a highly expressive paragraph speech synthesis system with a multi-step variational autoencoder, called EP-MSTTS.

arxiv-2407-18027.title: Are free groups of different ranks bi-invariantly quasi-isometric?
arxiv-2407-18027.creator: Jarek Kędra, Assaf Libman
arxiv-2407-18027.description: Abstract We prove that a homomorphism between free groups of finite rank equipped with the bi-invariant word metrics associated with finite generating sets is a quasi-isometry if and only if it is an isomorphism. † † 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification : Primary 20F65; Secondary 51F30. † † Key words and phrases : Free group; bi-invariant metric; word metric; quasi-isometry.

arxiv-2501-16079.title: Grain alignment and dust evolution physics with polarisation (GRADE-POL)
arxiv-2501-16079.creator: Le Ngoc Tram, Thiem Hoang, Alex Lazarian, Daniel Seifried, B-G Andersson, Thushara G.S. Pillai, Bao Truong, Pham Ngoc Diep, Lapo Fanciullo
arxiv-2501-16079.description: Abstract The polarisation of light induced by aligned interstellar dust serves as a significant tool in investigating cosmic magnetic fields and dust properties, while posing a challenge in characterising the polarisation of the cosmic microwave background and other sources. To establish dust polarisation as a reliable tool, the physics of the grain alignment process must be studied thoroughly.

arxiv-2502-15125.title: Weighted BMO-BLO estimates for Littlewood–Paley square operators
arxiv-2502-15125.creator: Runzhe Zhang and Hua Wang
arxiv-2502-15125.description: Abstract Let T ⁡ ( f ) T(f) denote the Littlewood–Paley square operators, including the Littlewood–Paley 𝒢 \mathcal{G} -function 𝒢 ⁡ ( f ) \mathcal{G}(f) , Lusin’s area integral 𝒮 ⁡ ( f ) \mathcal{S}(f) and Stein’s function 𝒢 λ ∗ ​ ( f ) \mathcal{G}^{\ast}_{\lambda}(f) with λ > 2 \lambda>2 .

arxiv-2503-11573.title: Synthesizing Access Control Policies using Large Language Models
arxiv-2503-11573.creator: 1 st Adarsh Vatsa, 2 nd Pratyush Patel, 3 rd William Eiers
arxiv-2503-11573.description: Abstract Cloud compute systems allow administrators to write access control policies that govern access to private data. While policies are written in convenient languages, such as AWS Identity and Access Management Policy Language, manually written policies often become complex and error prone.

pmc-10533381.title: Choriocarcinoma in tubal pregnancy: A case report
pmc-10533381.creator: Fateme Sadat Najib, Samaneh Bahrami, Zahra Shiravani, Seyed Mohammad Amin Alavi
pmc-10533381.description: Key Clinical MessageChoriocarcinoma of the fallopian tube is extremely rare and highly susceptible to early metastasis. Clinical manifestations of ectopic pregnancy and choriocarcinoma are the same, and all patients with ectopic pregnancy should be evaluated for choriocarcinoma based on histopathological findings. Adjuvant chemotherapy (after surgery) is the proposed treatment for tubal choriocarcinoma.

pmc-10667936.title: An exceptional cause of dyspnea: The uncommon case report of the association between Chilaiditi syndrome and diaphragmatic eventration
pmc-10667936.creator: Med Dheker Touati, Mohamed Raouf Ben Othmane, Fahd Khefacha, Anis Belhadj, Ahmed Saidani, Faouzi Chebbi
pmc-10667936.description: Introduction and importanceChilaiditi's syndrome, characterized by the abnormal positioning of the intestine between the diaphragm and liver, and diaphragmatic eventration, a condition marked by the permanent elevation of one side of the diaphragm, are both exceedingly uncommon medical conditions. Their co-occurrence is even rarer, with only a handful of documented cases in medical literature.

pmc-10700499.title: Mid-infrared supermirrors with finesse exceeding 400 000
pmc-10700499.creator: Gar-Wing Truong, Lukas W Perner, D Michelle Bailey, Georg Winkler, Seth B Cataño-Lopez, Valentin J Wittwer, Thomas Südmeyer, Catherine Nguyen, David Follman, Adam J Fleisher, Oliver H Heckl, Garrett D Cole
pmc-10700499.description: For trace gas sensing and precision spectroscopy, optical cavities incorporating low-loss mirrors are indispensable for path length and optical intensity enhancement. Optical interference coatings in the visible and near-infrared (NIR) spectral regions have achieved total optical losses below 2 parts per million (ppm), enabling a cavity finesse in excess of 1 million.

pmc-11430676.title: Real-Time fMRI Neurofeedback Training of Selective Attention in Older Adults
pmc-11430676.creator: Tian Lin, Mohit Rana, Peiwei Liu, Rebecca Polk, Amber Heemskerk, Steven M Weisberg, Dawn Bowers, Ranganatha Sitaram, Natalie C Ebner, Francesco Beritelli, Cristian Randieri, Samuele Russo
pmc-11430676.description: Background: Selective attention declines with age, due to age-related functional changes in dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC). Real-time functional magnetic resonance imaging (rtfMRI) neurofeedback has been used in young adults to train volitional control of brain activity, including in dACC.

pmc-11475781.title: A20 Alleviates the Inflammatory Response in Bovine Endometrial Epithelial Cells by Promoting Autophagy
pmc-11475781.creator: Junsheng Dong, Bowen Ji, Yeqi Jiang, Fan Fei, Long Guo, Kangjun Liu, Luying Cui, Xia Meng, Jianji Li, Heng Wang
pmc-11475781.description: Simple SummaryEndometritis is a prevalent disease in perinatal dairy cows, which leads to compromised reproductive function. Studies have confirmed that A20, also known as TNFAIP3, can regulate inflammatory responses in various cells. However, it remains unclear whether A20 regulates the inflammatory response of bovine endometrial cells and if autophagy plays a role in A20’s regulation of inflammatory responses.

pmc-11487883.title: Wealth-related inequalities in the utilisation of modern contraceptives in Papua New Guinea: evidence from the 2016–2018 Demographic and Health Survey data
pmc-11487883.creator: Louis Kobina Dadzie, Mainprice Akuoko Essuman, Eugene Budu, Edward Kwabena Ameyaw, Richard Gyan Aboagye, Bright Opoku Ahinkorah
pmc-11487883.description: ObjectiveTo examine the wealth-related disparities in modern contraceptives use among women in Papua New Guinea.DesignWe performed a cross-sectional analysis of the 2016–2018 Papua New Guinea Demographic and Health Survey data. We included 11 618 women of reproductive age in our final analysis. Percentages were used to present the results on utilisation of modern contraceptives.

pmc-12670538.title: Learning-dependent 4 Hz synchronization in the posterior striatum, lateral geniculate nucleus, and visual cortex
pmc-12670538.creator: Sai Tanimoto, Shigeyoshi Fujisawa
pmc-12670538.description: SummaryThe posterior striatum (pStr) is thought to play a crucial role in perceptual learning by maintaining stable sensory representations based on past experience and associating them with appropriate motor responses. However, how the pStr neuronal activity acquires these representations, in particular the functional significance of the interactions between the pStr and its sensory input regions, remains largely unexplored.

pmc-12843268.title: Types of Challenges and Barriers in Accessing Paediatric Palliative Care in Romania: A Qualitative Study Based on Focus Groups Guided by a Semi-Structured Discussion Guide
pmc-12843268.creator: Mihaela Hizanu Dumitrache, Liviu Stafie, Alina Plesea-Condratovici, Dana Elena Mindru, Camer Salim, Eva Maria Elkan, Mădălina Duceac Covrig, Mădălina Nicoleta Matei, Ciprian Adrian Dinu, Letiția Doina Duceac
pmc-12843268.description: Background and Objectives: Paediatric palliative care in Romania is underdeveloped and unevenly distributed, which creates major difficulties in accessing services for children with life-limiting illnesses and their families. The lack of a dedicated national strategy, the shortage of specialised staff, and socio-economic barriers exacerbate the vulnerability of these groups.

pmc-12853715.title: Association between inflammatory markers and Parkinson’s disease risk: a cross-sectional, propensity score-matched analysis of NHANES data
pmc-12853715.creator: Yue Sun, Shuang Li, Shengming Shi, Yan Liu
pmc-12853715.description: BackgroundParkinson’s disease (PD) is a chronic neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor and non-motor symptoms, with neuroinflammation hypothesized to contribute to its pathogenesis. Systemic inflammation, as indicated by elevated peripheral inflammatory markers, has been implicated in PD; however, the relationship between complete blood count (CBC)-derived inflammatory markers and the presence of PD remains unclear.

pmc-13185804.title: Green simultaneous quantification of levodopa, carbidopa, and benserazide in anti-Parkinson's tablets by ATR-FTIR spectroscopy combined with hurdle modelling and machine learning
pmc-13185804.creator: Manh Huy Nguyen, Thanh Dam Nguyen, Hong Anh Duong, Hung Viet Pham
pmc-13185804.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In this study, an integrated hurdle modelling workflow combining ATR-FTIR and machine learning was developed for the simultaneous quantification of levodopa (LD), carbidopa (CD), and benserazide (BZ) in anti-Parkinson's medication. A calibration set of 103 synthetic pellets was prepared with wide concentration ranges for the three active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), 0–80% w/w for LD, 0–40% w/w for BZ; and 0–8% w/w for CD, and analysed by ATR-FTIR and HPLC-DAD reference method.

pmc-13530992.title: The Impact of Adherence to Cancer Prevention Recommendations on Cancer Incidence and Mortality in a Cohort of Canadian Adults
pmc-13530992.creator: Samuel Selorm Fiati Kenston, Rachel A. Murphy, Jerry M. Spiegel, Trevor J.B. Dummer
pmc-13530992.description: Background:Adherence to the World Cancer Research Fund/American Institute for Cancer Research cancer prevention recommendations has been associated with reduced cancer risk; however, Canadian evidence remains limited. We examined associations between adherence to these recommendations and cancer incidence and mortality in a Canadian cohort.

pmc-13639158.title: Risk factors associated with the development of multidrug-resistant bloodstream infection in patients with colonization: a case-control retrospective study
pmc-13639158.creator: Jinan Al Jadeedi, Majada Allouyahi, Rouya Al Busaidi, Shatha Al Riyami, Abdullah Balkhair
pmc-13639158.description: Highlights•Colonization with multidrug-resistant organism (MDRO) is an important risk factor for the subsequent development of bloodstream infection (BSI).•A total of 12.9% of patients were co-colonized with two or more MDROs.•A total of 6.1% of MDRO colonization events progressed to BSI by the same colonizing MDRO.•Concordance between MDRO colonization and subsequent BSI was 45.3% of BSI events.
